name: backward-interleaving-canonical
description: One replica inserts 'b' then prepends 'a' before it; another concurrently inserts 'x'. This is the execution where RGA produces axb.

expected.rationale: Backward non-interleaving, single replica. RGA yields axb here (arXiv A.1.8); Table 1 proves Fugue does not. This trace is the reason the project uses FugueMax rather than RGA.
